title: Understanding k-Medians
text: In k-Medians, the cluster center is the median of the data points in the cluster. This is different from k-Means, where the center is the mean of the data points.

title: Initial Cluster Centers
text: The initial cluster centers are given as $$2$$ and $$7$$. We need to determine the new cluster centers after the first reassignment.

title: Assign Data Points to Clusters
text: Assign each data point to the nearest cluster center. Calculate the distance of each data point from the cluster centers $$2$$ and $$7$$.

title: Calculate New Cluster Centers
text: After assigning data points to clusters, calculate the median of each cluster to find the new cluster centers.

title: Verify the New Cluster Centers
text: Check if the calculated medians are indeed the new cluster centers by verifying the data points in each cluster.
